The exit-realization bound uses _maxLossBps (61 bps for USDe) on the exit leg alone, so a resume or verifier leg bounds the USDe exit leg, not the round trip. Story 087 Concerns acknowledge this (a knowing owner decision under Law 3), so it is not filed. It is parked here because it compounds NEW-01's observation that only the re-deposit leg is checked per user by the verifier. If NEW-01 recommendation 4 (a per-user total check) is declined, a human should re-evaluate whether the USDe total is bounded anywhere except the aggregate.

test_P7_everyHaltPoint_breakerLive_resumeConverges scores 'LIVE' when Pauser.pause() does not revert and every currently registered contract is paused. It does not check whether V2 or Antimatter is reachable, so it reported halt 5 as LIVE and missed the NEW-02 window. The test also runs its resume in preview mode (previewFlag = true) and forks at 25981150, not the live block. Future breaker-liveness probes (audit harness and the project's Phase-8 probe) should assert that the target contracts are paused, not only that pause() did not revert.
